settings.agents.costMeterDisclosure: Shows Claude Code's own estimate (list price; on a subscription that is API-equivalent value, not a bill) and context use in each Claude pane header, in Mission Control and in Fleet. Gridkeeper starts Claude with a --settings file in its own data folder that sets only statusLine and, while “Exact status for Claude panes (hooks)” below is on (the default), Claude Code hooks. Claude then hands Gridkeeper the status line numbers: session id, cost, durations, context size and use, token counts, the current usage breakdown, rate limits and the model name; from the hooks Gridkeeper keeps only the event, tool name, notification type and session id. Nothing from transcripts or credentials is read. It replaces Claude's status line in Gridkeeper panes, unless you have your own: then Gridkeeper runs yours and it shows as before (it finds it by reading statusLine and disableAllHooks from your Claude settings files, read-only). Your own hooks keep running unchanged. A pane that passes its own --settings isn't metered and gets no hooks. Codex and Gemini CLI report no usage to other programs (shown as n/a). Applies to newly started Claude panes: restart a pane to apply.
meter.enabledToastHooks: Cost meter on: Claude panes started from now on report cost, context and their exact status (Claude Code hooks in the same settings file). Restart a running pane to apply.
meter.hintDisclosure: Shows Claude Code's own cost estimate and context use for each Claude pane. From the status line command Gridkeeper reads only the numbers Claude Code hands it (cost, context, tokens, model, rate limits), never transcripts or credentials. With “Exact status for Claude panes (hooks)” on (the default), the same settings file also adds Claude Code hooks; from those Gridkeeper keeps only the event, tool name, notification type and session id. Applies to Claude panes started after you turn it on.
